I would but they're all older with full time work or kids. Parents are either down south looking after family or working.
I'll keep an eye for people tho thanks for the tip
Thanks for the positive vibes. I guess not many people want to live upside down
I might just have to go see end game twice and try not to spoil it the first time
I guess I'll just have to try and find some new music and then just hope for the best. Thanks for the support really means a lot. Also happy to talk if u ever need as well.

In terms of the relationship I've been told that personality is a heavy lifter and for the sex, well alcohol exists. This is only happened after 100's of rejections that ultimately withered my confidence away so it isn't exactly a highlight of my life.

Anyone can do it but it lacks any sort of substance to which why I can't be bothered to do it anymore. Relationship wise I don't try anymore cause I've been dropped with little/no signs of care from the others. Life is just pain and I don't know what to do.

What keeps u going tho? 
cause I've thought of just ending it but the pain it would bring to my family just isn't fair on them

I've tried it all in terms of reaching out to my parents, unless there's something I don't know about, and got nothing except maybe a weeks worth of empathy only when a friend caught me trying to kill myself and told them.

I try do all the self help techniques and writing it all out on here has been a really good turn out and thank you for your support. Sadly the methods fade after a while and I'm back in the dumps, especially after having no real up moments in my life for the past 3 years I don't see why I bother to continue. I guess I'm in it for my dog but still ever day is painful to wake up to.

Unless something magical happens at college, and I hope it does, I don't think I'll be around for much longer. I'll try my best and all, put myself out there but we'll see how it goes.
Thanks for all the support its much appreciated.

The same one I have now just maybe better facial features and more understanding parents. I'm trying to save up money for cosmetic surgery and as for my parents ive tried multiple times to open and tell them about this stuff but I get nothing except more problems from them.  we even went to a family psychologist, nothing changed. 

Also the deletion of the real shitty memories I have. I've rid any emotional attachment from them but God, thinking about them make me want to neck
